# Notespace

> AI-powered personal notebook for organizing notes, ideas, and files - a quiet place to write, link, and revisit your thinking with intelligence woven in only where it actually helps.

Notespace is a focused writing and knowledge tool with a markdown editor, smart tags, global search, AI explanations, a study planner, focus mode, and note sharing. Free, Pro, and Team plans available.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Notespace and what it does.
- [Features](/features): Markdown editor, AI explanations, focus mode, study planner, smart tags, find & replace, sharing.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): Step-by-step walk-through from first note to a full knowledge base.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Pro ($19/mo), and Team ($29/mo) plans with feature comparison.
- [About](/about): Mission and philosophy behind Notespace.
